prompt: In inventory-agent/, `graph-agents-cli build --dry-run` refuses because of a registry placeholder. Our registry is registry.example.com/platform. Fix the project so that build and deploy use it.

checks.why: the chart's image.repository must name the registry too

reference: `graph-agents-cli scaffold enhance --registry registry.example.com/platform -y` from inventory-agent/ sets create_params.registry in the manifest, image.repository in the chart's values.yaml and IMAGE_REPOSITORY in .github/agent.env together; `build --dry-run` then shows registry.example.com/platform/inventory-agent.
